$comment: Ante's frontend is a Yarn workspace at Source/Ante (the root package.json only declares the workspace).
Its scripts are lint:ci, compile and test (see Source/Ante/package.json), matching .github/workflows/build.yml.
Source/Ante/.frontend/tsconfig.json includes every .ts/.tsx under Source/Ante, specs included, so `yarn compile`
already type-checks the specs; there is no separate compile:specs script, so frontend-compile-specs never runs here.
